name_en: Isahaya keihan — a simple mixed rice of chicken traditionally cooked by the men of the house
summary_ja: 自宅で育てた鶏をさばき、米と炊き合わせるだけの素朴な混ぜご飯。諫早市目代地区に伝わり、正月や盆に男衆がつくるのが習わしとされ、地元では鶏を意味する「とい」から「といめし」とも呼ばれるという。
summary_en: Chicken raised at home is butchered and cooked simply with rice into a mixed dish — passed down in Isahaya's Medai district, traditionally made by the men of the household at New Year and Obon, and also called "toimeshi" from a local word for chicken.
